Messages.Author: David Naseby
Messages.Body:
Situation: Muddled vampire hunter attacks a vampire with three blood and
a murder of crows (for example). Vampire is torpored with first strike.
Does the murder of crows still kill the vampire hunter, or are they a
bit distraught about the slaying of their beloved master?

David Naseby

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:


Distraught.

Crows (and other retainers) deal their damage during their employer's
strike resolution (the initial strike resolution only, in case of
additional strikes).

If their employer doesn't make it to his strike reoslution phase, ...

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team

Messages.Author: Rubbduck
Messages.Body:
> Situation: Muddled vampire hunter attacks a vampire with three blood and
> a murder of crows (for example). Vampire is torpored with first strike.
> Does the murder of crows still kill the vampire hunter, or are they a
> bit distraught about the slaying of their beloved master?

The murder of crows is a retainer, and as such is automatically burned
when the vampire they lie on is burned, so they don't get a chance to
attack.

Rubber Duck

Messages.Author: Chris Shorb
Messages.Body:


No doubt LSJ will bring to bear his rapier sharp analysis and gargantuan
database of V:TES lore, but just to quib, the vamp would only be going to
torpor, and as such would not lose the boids. Retainer damage of the
avian or canine variety takes place outside of the strike phase
(methinks). However, going to torpor is an immediate combat ends
(although not technically a "combat ends". If you go to torpor, combat
just ends). I would have to vote with the damage does not get dealt by
Eric Draven's kine...

Messages.Author: Dan Hollis
Messages.Body:
LSJ (VtES Rep) wrote:

>
> Crows (and other retainers) deal their damage during their employer's
> strike resolution (the initial strike resolution only, in case of
> additional strikes).
>
> If their employer doesn't make it to his strike reoslution phase,

LSJ, suppose 2 minions are in combat, and one employs
a murder of crows. Does this mean that if both use a S:CE, that
the crows' damage occurs?

Dan

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:


No. S:CE terminates the strike resolution phase before any damage is
done. (Rulebook section 8.3)


